A '''topato''' was a type of [[Foodstuff|food]] that grew on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Galaxies /> They were used as an ingredient in various dishes such as [[topato soup]]. At [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], three slices of topatoes were served as a dinner side for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. The [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] also used tapatoes to make its [[Besh-Leth-Trill sandwich]]es, [[fruit juice/Legends|fruit juice]], [[gartro egg omelet]]es, [[shaak and cheese sandwich]]es, and [[Shawda Clubb sandwich]]es as well as topato slices in its [[Coruscant slider]]. The diner also served [[Aurebesh soup]] that was made with [[pasta]] shapes in topato soup.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Topatoes first appeared in the [[1995]] novel [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] written by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="Children of the Jedi">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>
